figures.measure: DS-11 under-16 first passport: government application fee
figures.source: U.S. Department of State, Travel.State.gov, "Passport Fees" (fee chart)
figures.quote: For children under 16 applying for a passport using Form DS-11: Passport book: $100 application fee + $35 facility acceptance fee. Passport card: $15 application fee + $35 facility acceptance fee. Passport book and card: $115 application fee + $35 facility acceptance fee. The application fee is paid directly to the Department of State, the execution/acceptance fee is paid directly to the acceptance facility.

figures.measure: DS-11 under-16 first passport: execution/acceptance fee charged by the acceptance facility
figures.source: U.S. Department of State, Travel.State.gov, "Passport Fees" (fee chart)
figures.quote: Passport book: $100 application fee + $35 facility acceptance fee. ... Every application for a minor is a new in-person application with both parents or guardians, so the $35 execution fee always applies.

figures.measure: standard (routine) processing time, not counting mail time
figures.source: U.S. Department of State (travel.state.gov), as quoted by Travel + Leisure/Yahoo Travel, "U.S. passport processing times explained: How long does it take to get a passport in 2026?"
figures.quote: Routine passport processing currently takes four to six weeks from the time your completed application is submitted, according to the State Department. ... this timeframe does not include mailing time. Officials recommend adding an extra two weeks for transit, bringing the total to approximately six to eight weeks.

figures.measure: child passport (age 0-15, 5-year validity, applied for inside Canada), fee effective March 31 2026
figures.source: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC), Canada.ca, "How to apply for a child passport in Canada" / fee page, as quoted by Service Canada Passport Services, "Canadian Passport Fees 2026: New Fee Changes & Service Delivery Updates"
figures.quote: Child passport (under 16, 5-year validity only) now costs $58.50 in Canada (up $1.50 from $57). ... This fee applies to applications received on or after March 31, 2026. Child passports are only issued with 5-year validity; there is no 10-year option for applicants under 16.

figures.measure: standard processing time for an application made in person at a Service Canada Centre or passport office, or by mail, inside Canada
figures.value: 10 to 20 business days, plus mail time
figures.source: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC), Canada.ca, "How to apply for a child passport in Canada"
figures.quote: 10 to 20 business days, plus mail time. This applies when applicants use a Service Canada Centre or passport office in person, or apply by mail. Go to a passport office for faster processing (10 business days) versus a Service Canada Centre (20 business days); mail applications also take 20 business days plus delivery time.

figures.measure: service guarantee: application free of charge if not processed within guarantee window (effective April 1 2026)
figures.source: IRCC / Canada.ca, as quoted by Service Canada Passport Services and TravelersToday, "Canadian Passport Processing in 2026: 10-Day Standard, New Fees, and a Hidden Trap"
figures.quote: Starting April 1, 2026, complete passport applications must be processed within 30 business days or the passport is free. Since 1 April 2026, the '30 days or free' guarantee automatically refunds the passport fee if a complete application takes longer than 30 business days to process.

figures.measure: child (under 16) standard 34-page passport fee, digital/online application

figures.measure: child (under 16) standard 34-page passport fee, paper application

figures.measure: standard processing time: online vs postal application

figures.quote: UK passport processing time in 2026 is, on average, three weeks for online applications and up to 10 weeks for postal applications. ... HM Passport Office advises allowing up to 10 weeks to be safe, particularly between June and August.

figures.measure: Passport Online: standard 5-year passport for a child
figures.source: Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), Ireland.ie / DFA.ie, "Passport Fees"
figures.quote: A standard 5-year passport for a child is €20 when applying using Passport Online, and a large 66-page 5-year passport for a child is €50. There is an additional €5 postal fee for each child application to cover the cost of returning documents to the applicant, and the postal fee is €15 if you live outside Ireland.

figures.measure: Post Passport Service (equivalent of the former Passport Express) for a child under 18
figures.source: Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), Ireland.ie / DFA.ie, "Passport Fees"
figures.quote: A standard 5-year passport for those under 18 years costs €30 through the Post Passport Service. The fee for a single application is €9.50 and the fee for up to four applications made at the same time is €16 for postal costs.

figures.measure: turnaround time, first-time online application (adult and child)
figures.source: Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), "Current Turnaround Times"
figures.quote: For a First Time Online Application (Adult and Child), the current average turnaround time is 10 Working Days. However, it's important to note that all applications for children are considered complex renewals because the consent of all guardians has to be verified. For child renewals specifically, the current average turnaround time is 15 Working Days.

figures.measure: average saving achieved by buyers who successfully negotiated, in money and as a share of asking price

figures.quote: Fewer than a third of car buyers (29%) always try to negotiate when buying a vehicle. ... those who had successfully negotiated a car's price managed to save, on average, £896. ... an average of 11% off the total asking price by those who negotiated successfully.

figures.measure: share of buyers who always negotiate price
figures.source: CarGurus UK press release / 2023 UK Consumer Insight Report
figures.quote: Fewer than a third of car buyers (29%) always try to negotiate when buying a vehicle.

figures.measure: share of used-car buyers who do not haggle over price at all
figures.source: CarGurus survey of 750 UK adults, as quoted by The Car Expert, "A third of buyers don't haggle on a used car"
figures.quote: More than a third of used car buyers (38%) do not haggle over the price, according to research by CarGurus involving 750 UK adults. ... Nearly three out of 10 non-negotiators (29%) said this was because they either do not know how to, are concerned about insulting the seller or do not feel comfortable doing it.

figures.measure: new-vehicle average transaction price (ATP) vs average MSRP, and incentive spending as a share of ATP
figures.unit: USD ATP vs 51621 USD MSRP; incentives = 6.4% of ATP
figures.source: Cox Automotive / Kelley Blue Book, "Kelley Blue Book Report: New-Vehicle Prices Trend Higher in July as Incentives Decline and Sales Pace Slows," dated August 11, 2026
figures.quote: Incentive spending declined in July and was lower for the second consecutive month, falling to 6.4% of ATP. ... July ATP: $49,855. July MSRP: $51,621. June 2026 incentives equaled 7% of ATP. July 2025 (year-ago) incentive spending averaged 7.3% of ATP.

figures.measure: average days for a used car to sell (Auto Trader marketplace-wide figure, by fuel type), May 2026

figures.quote: used EVs taking an average of just 24 days to sell, ahead of both petrol (29 days) and diesel (32 days). Data tables: 'Fastest-selling used cars – May 2026.'

figures.quote: The average used car took 53 days to sell as of February 2026, according to iSeeCars data. ... since August 2025, the monthly average days on market has increased to 40 to 50 days.
